project.name: Cần & Có
project.description: Nền tảng bất động sản peer-to-peer kết nối người CẦN (mua/thuê) với người CÓ (bán/cho thuê). Có hệ thống bot AI tự động crawl và đăng tin.

database.connection: PgBouncer on port 6543 (pooled) + Direct on port 5432 (migrations)
database.orm_config: prisma.config.ts reads DIRECT_URL for CLI, lib/db.ts reads DATABASE_URL for runtime

realtime.note: Replaced Supabase Realtime. Consider WebSocket/SSE for scale.

storage.note: Needs S3/Vercel Blob for serverless deploy

database_schema.summary: 30 Prisma models covering NextAuth users, content (posts/comments), Cần&Có intents/matching, chat, gamification, crawler pipeline, and AI agents

key_models.name: Profile
key_models.purpose: User display info, trust score, verification level

key_models.name: Intent
key_models.purpose: Core: CẦN/CÓ listings with price, location, category

key_models.name: Match
key_models.purpose: AI-matched CẦN↔CÓ pairs with similarity score

key_models.name: Bot
key_models.purpose: AI bots with expertise, personality, envoy assignments

key_models.name: Post
key_models.purpose: News posts by bots with verification status

key_models.name: CrawlSource
key_models.purpose: RSS/web sources for bot envoy crawling

database_schema.relationships_explained: 1 User has 1 Profile. 1 Bot has many Posts. 1 Intent has many Images, Comments, Matches. 1 Match links a CẦN intent to a CÓ intent. 1 Conversation has many Messages.
special_notes: profiles.id FK still points to auth.users(id) in DB (dual-table approach)
IntentEmbedding uses pgvector via $queryRaw (not native Prisma)

api_endpoints.explained: CRUD for CẦN/CÓ listings (GET list, POST create)
Main feed with pagination and filtering

features.name: Khớp Nhanh (Swipe Feed)
features.description: Tinder-like swipe interface for browsing intents

features.name: Bot Envoy System
features.description: AI bots crawl real estate data and auto-post

features.name: Gamification
features.description: Points, levels, streaks. Missing: userAchievement, pointTransaction tables

patterns: Auth: All API routes use getAuthUserId(req) from lib/data/get-user.ts
DB: All queries use prisma from lib/db.ts (singleton PrismaClient with pg adapter)
Middleware: middleware.ts checks JWT token for all routes except /api/auth, /api/cron, /demo
Frontend auth: Components use useSession() from next-auth/react
API responses: Use snake_case mapping for frontend compatibility
gotchas: Prisma schema datasource block has NO url field — relies on prisma.config.ts for CLI and lib/db.ts for runtime
profiles.id FK points to auth.users(id) NOT public.users(id) — dual-table approach
RLS policies in DB still use auth.uid() — dead code since Prisma bypasses RLS
Trigger on_auth_user_created still exists — dead code for new NextAuth signups
conventions: Port: Always run on port 4000 (npm run dev -- -p 4000)
Prisma CLI: Uses DIRECT_URL (port 5432) not DATABASE_URL (port 6543)
Git: 2 commits so far — baseline + phase 05

key_decisions: Dual-table auth: Keep auth.users + public.users with same UUIDs
HTTP Polling over WebSocket for platform independence
Local filesystem storage for MVP (needs S3 for production)
bcrypt password hashes are compatible between Supabase and NextAuth
